The two likelihoods have full-rank (1,X) designs; the anchor success/failure covariate values force the separation recession cone to be {0}, giving finite maximizers, and strict concavity gives uniqueness. Independent 75-digit score solves and enumeration give SD=0.24709175059459 and SD(Vhat)=0.01256670238997. All logs are of positive probabilities.

The required biased three-unit example is also an explicit closed assertion, not an assumption.

These probability, independence and covariance facts are checked directly in scratch/Check.lean.

Thus the sufficient-condition part has genuine models; the deterministic-prediction and allocationwise identities have no additional antecedent.
